meta.title: Villains and Vigilantes
meta.description: A new destination appears as a solution to the conundrum arrives from afar.

units.rawText: Shopping street, still in construction.
units.displayText: Shopping street, still in construction.

spans.text: Shopping street, still in construction.

units.rawText: Not a trace of her... that Florence is a fox, doesn't leave even a shadow behind.
units.displayText: Not a trace of her... that Florence is a fox, doesn't leave even a shadow behind.

spans.text: Not a trace of her... that Florence is a fox, doesn't leave even a shadow behind.

units.rawText: It won't do any good for us to wander aimlessly. We should go meet up with Croque and Sakuya first, no? Perhaps they have some new clues after talking to the Professor.
units.displayText: It won't do any good for us to wander aimlessly. We should go meet up with Croque and Sakuya first, no? Perhaps they have some new clues after talking to the Professor.

spans.text: It won't do any good for us to wander aimlessly. We should go meet up with Croque and Sakuya first, no? Perhaps they have some new clues after talking to the Professor.

units.rawText: No, I can't just return empty-handed like this!
units.displayText: No, I can't just return empty-handed like this!

spans.text: No, I can't just return empty-handed like this!

units.rawText: I can't believe Florence hoodwinked me like that! I'm going to introduce her to the distinctions of the martial arts!
units.displayText: I can't believe Florence hoodwinked me like that! I'm going to introduce her to the distinctions of the martial arts!

spans.text: I can't believe Florence hoodwinked me like that! I'm going to introduce her to the distinctions of the martial arts!

units.rawText: And that accomplice of hers...
units.displayText: And that accomplice of hers...

spans.text: And that accomplice of hers...

units.rawText: Yeah! That spineless coward—if it wasn't for those drones getting in our way, we never would've lost her.
units.displayText: Yeah! That spineless coward—if it wasn't for those drones getting in our way, we never would've lost her.

spans.text: Yeah! That spineless coward—if it wasn't for those drones getting in our way, we never would've lost her.

units.rawText: Truth be told, I suspect that Kuro is that accomplice.
units.displayText: Truth be told, I suspect that Kuro is that accomplice.

spans.text: Truth be told, I suspect that Kuro is that accomplice.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: According to Croque, there shouldn't be anyone else on the event grounds.
units.displayText: According to Croque, there shouldn't be anyone else on the event grounds.

spans.text: According to Croque, there shouldn't be anyone else on the event grounds.

units.rawText: So if Kuro is...
units.displayText: So if Kuro is...

spans.text: So if Kuro is...

units.rawText: We've been tricked twice, then.
units.displayText: We've been tricked twice, then.

spans.text: We've been tricked twice, then.

units.rawText: Krak—
units.displayText: Krak—

spans.text: Krak—

units.rawText: Jiangyu's eyebrows furrow. Her two hands meet, and their joints crackle and pop.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's eyebrows furrow. Her two hands meet, and their joints crackle and pop.

spans.text: Jiangyu's eyebrows furrow. Her two hands meet, and their joints crackle and pop.

units.rawText: For her sake, she'd better not let me catch her...
units.displayText: For her sake, she'd better not let me catch her...

spans.text: For her sake, she'd better not let me catch her...

units.rawText: Beeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeep—

units.rawText: This is Aki. Apologies, but we've failed to find Florence.
units.displayText: This is Aki. Apologies, but we've failed to find Florence.

spans.text: This is Aki. Apologies, but we've failed to find Florence.

units.rawText: No matter, we've got a lead on our other target. The first thing up on the stream section of the Oasis net was all we needed.
units.displayText: No matter, we've got a lead on our other target. The first thing up on the stream section of the Oasis net was all we needed.

spans.text: No matter, we've got a lead on our other target. The first thing up on the stream section of the Oasis net was all we needed.

units.rawText: Kuro's using us as entertainment material. Judging by what she's got in the shot, she shouldn't be too far from you.
units.displayText: Kuro's using us as entertainment material. Judging by what she's got in the shot, she shouldn't be too far from you.

spans.text: Kuro's using us as entertainment material. Judging by what she's got in the shot, she shouldn't be too far from you.

units.rawText: We've got some other stuff to take care of, so I'll leave her to you.
units.displayText: We've got some other stuff to take care of, so I'll leave her to you.

spans.text: We've got some other stuff to take care of, so I'll leave her to you.

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: What did Croque say?
units.displayText: What did Croque say?

spans.text: What did Croque say?

units.rawText: We've indeed been tricked twice. Get your warmups done—we've got the little idiot's hiding place.
units.displayText: We've indeed been tricked twice. Get your warmups done—we've got the little idiot's hiding place.

spans.text: We've indeed been tricked twice. Get your warmups done—we've got the little idiot's hiding place.

units.rawText: Hehe, let's put an end to this game of cat and mouse!
units.displayText: Hehe, let's put an end to this game of cat and mouse!

spans.text: Hehe, let's put an end to this game of cat and mouse!

units.rawText: Event grounds, security room 3.
units.displayText: Event grounds, security room 3.

spans.text: Event grounds, security room 3.

units.rawText: Kuro squeezes into the midst of a group of security statues, talking smack at the screens around her.
units.displayText: Kuro squeezes into the midst of a group of security statues, talking smack at the screens around her.

spans.text: Kuro squeezes into the midst of a group of security statues, talking smack at the screens around her.

units.rawText: What do you mean I'm running it down? I'm being griefed by my teammates!
units.displayText: What do you mean I'm running it down? I'm being griefed by my teammates!

spans.text: What do you mean I'm running it down? I'm being griefed by my teammates!

units.rawText: If Florence wasn't here, I'd be able to go anywhere I wanted with my perfect disguise!
units.displayText: If Florence wasn't here, I'd be able to go anywhere I wanted with my perfect disguise!

spans.text: If Florence wasn't here, I'd be able to go anywhere I wanted with my perfect disguise!

units.rawText: My ass gets beat? Hmph, they'll have to find me first!
units.displayText: My ass gets beat? Hmph, they'll have to find me first!

spans.text: My ass gets beat? Hmph, they'll have to find me first!

units.rawText: Do you know where I am? I'm at the festival's security room! They say the most dangerous place is also the safest. There's no way they look here.
units.displayText: Do you know where I am? I'm at the festival's security room! They say the most dangerous place is also the safest. There's no way they look here.

spans.text: Do you know where I am? I'm at the festival's security room! They say the most dangerous place is also the safest. There's no way they look here.

units.rawText: <color=red>Chat</color> is this what they mean by running it down?<|> <color=red>Chat</color> that's our strummer, walking into the slammer like it's her home.

units.rawText: Tch, you guys just want to see me suffer.
units.displayText: Tch, you guys just want to see me suffer.

spans.text: Tch, you guys just want to see me suffer.

units.rawText: Whew, time to chill for a bit. Dunno where Florence's gone, but I hope she got away.
units.displayText: Whew, time to chill for a bit. Dunno where Florence's gone, but I hope she got away.

spans.text: Whew, time to chill for a bit. Dunno where Florence's gone, but I hope she got away.

units.rawText: Relax, she's gone. We didn't manage to catch Florence.
units.displayText: Relax, she's gone. We didn't manage to catch Florence.

spans.text: Relax, she's gone. We didn't manage to catch Florence.

units.rawText: Well, thank goodness for that. If she did, I wouldn't even know where to go to ask for my money on the... drones.
units.displayText: Well, thank goodness for that. If she did, I wouldn't even know where to go to ask for my money on the... drones.

spans.text: Well, thank goodness for that. If she did, I wouldn't even know where to go to ask for my money on the... drones.

units.rawText: S**T!
units.displayText: S**T!

spans.text: S**T!

units.rawText: Taste death, Kuro!
units.displayText: Taste death, Kuro!

spans.text: Taste death, Kuro!

units.rawText: I'm a good guy; don't get any closer, ahhhhh!
units.displayText: I'm a good guy; don't get any closer, ahhhhh!

spans.text: I'm a good guy; don't get any closer, ahhhhh!

units.rawText: Kuro tumbles backwards, unfurling her jacket, a swathe of drone control chips hidden on the inside.
units.displayText: Kuro tumbles backwards, unfurling her jacket, a swathe of drone control chips hidden on the inside.

spans.text: Kuro tumbles backwards, unfurling her jacket, a swathe of drone control chips hidden on the inside.

units.rawText: H... hey, how about we all just talk about this like good, reasonable people? You know, since it's the new year and all.
units.displayText: H... hey, how about we all just talk about this like good, reasonable people? You know, since it's the new year and all.

spans.text: H... hey, how about we all just talk about this like good, reasonable people? You know, since it's the new year and all.

units.rawText: How did you find me anyway? I'm not even the one on the front lines; why am I the first one out? That doesn't make any sense!
units.displayText: How did you find me anyway? I'm not even the one on the front lines; why am I the first one out? That doesn't make any sense!

spans.text: How did you find me anyway? I'm not even the one on the front lines; why am I the first one out? That doesn't make any sense!

units.rawText: I even told you on the way here, what do you think?
units.displayText: I even told you on the way here, what do you think?

spans.text: I even told you on the way here, what do you think?

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: "Strummer, are you going to cry as much as you've talked when your ass gets beat later?"
units.displayText: "Strummer, are you going to cry as much as you've talked when your ass gets beat later?"

spans.text: "Strummer, are you going to cry as much as you've talked when your ass gets beat later?"

units.rawText: Y-you streamsniped me! You can't just do that!
units.displayText: Y-you streamsniped me! You can't just do that!

spans.text: Y-you streamsniped me! You can't just do that!

units.rawText: You like bailing Florence out, huh? Don't even think about running!
units.displayText: You like bailing Florence out, huh? Don't even think about running!

spans.text: You like bailing Florence out, huh? Don't even think about running!

units.rawText: CRACK—
units.displayText: CRACK—

spans.text: CRACK—

units.rawText: Her countenance is stone-still, and Jiangyu's leg moves behind her, crushing a silently approaching drone.
units.displayText: Her countenance is stone-still, and Jiangyu's leg moves behind her, crushing a silently approaching drone.

spans.text: Her countenance is stone-still, and Jiangyu's leg moves behind her, crushing a silently approaching drone.

units.rawText: Whoooaahhh, I... I can explain!
units.displayText: Whoooaahhh, I... I can explain!

spans.text: Whoooaahhh, I... I can explain!

units.rawText: A forced smile on her face, Kuro takes another half-step back, running into a security statue behind her.
units.displayText: A forced smile on her face, Kuro takes another half-step back, running into a security statue behind her.

spans.text: A forced smile on her face, Kuro takes another half-step back, running into a security statue behind her.

units.rawText: Krak—krak—
units.displayText: Krak—krak—

spans.text: Krak—krak—

units.rawText: Oh, come on! I get it if you want to hit me or whatever, but isn't going straight to security systems a step too far?
units.displayText: Oh, come on! I get it if you want to hit me or whatever, but isn't going straight to security systems a step too far?

spans.text: Oh, come on! I get it if you want to hit me or whatever, but isn't going straight to security systems a step too far?

units.rawText: Jiangyu?
units.displayText: Jiangyu?

spans.text: Jiangyu?

units.rawText: Huh? What is it?
units.displayText: Huh? What is it?

spans.text: Huh? What is it?

units.rawText: ...That wasn't me, I didn't do anything. All I did was punt that drone.
units.displayText: ...That wasn't me, I didn't do anything. All I did was punt that drone.

spans.text: ...That wasn't me, I didn't do anything. All I did was punt that drone.

units.rawText: The three look around with suspicion as the noise nearby multiplies.
units.displayText: The three look around with suspicion as the noise nearby multiplies.

spans.text: The three look around with suspicion as the noise nearby multiplies.

units.rawText: The statues in the room collectively light up, turning towards the three simultaneously, wordlessly synchronous.
units.displayText: The statues in the room collectively light up, turning towards the three simultaneously, wordlessly synchronous.

spans.text: The statues in the room collectively light up, turning towards the three simultaneously, wordlessly synchronous.

units.rawText: Something's off, Jiangyu. Be on your guard.
units.displayText: Something's off, Jiangyu. Be on your guard.

spans.text: Something's off, Jiangyu. Be on your guard.

units.rawText: Oi, you can't just leave me here!
units.displayText: Oi, you can't just leave me here!

spans.text: Oi, you can't just leave me here!

units.rawText: Duck!
units.displayText: Duck!

spans.text: Duck!

units.rawText: Kuro sits dumbstruck for a second, but immediately catches on as Jiangyu dashes at her, tumbling to the ground.
units.displayText: Kuro sits dumbstruck for a second, but immediately catches on as Jiangyu dashes at her, tumbling to the ground.

spans.text: Kuro sits dumbstruck for a second, but immediately catches on as Jiangyu dashes at her, tumbling to the ground.

units.rawText: Jiangyu dashes past her, knocking back a statue with a single blow.
units.displayText: Jiangyu dashes past her, knocking back a statue with a single blow.

spans.text: Jiangyu dashes past her, knocking back a statue with a single blow.

units.rawText: Wow, that's hard...
units.displayText: Wow, that's hard...

spans.text: Wow, that's hard...

units.rawText: They're made to ensure safety here, after all. Why'd they activate all of a sudden, though? They were in hibernation just moments before...
units.displayText: They're made to ensure safety here, after all. Why'd they activate all of a sudden, though? They were in hibernation just moments before...

spans.text: They're made to ensure safety here, after all. Why'd they activate all of a sudden, though? They were in hibernation just moments before...

units.rawText: How do I put this... this brings up some unpleasant memories for me. In any case, I'm outta here!
units.displayText: How do I put this... this brings up some unpleasant memories for me. In any case, I'm outta here!

spans.text: How do I put this... this brings up some unpleasant memories for me. In any case, I'm outta here!

units.rawText: You!
units.displayText: You!

spans.text: You!

units.rawText: Sorry, but the security systems seem to be intent on helping me... eh?
units.displayText: Sorry, but the security systems seem to be intent on helping me... eh?

spans.text: Sorry, but the security systems seem to be intent on helping me... eh?

units.rawText: Kuro bolts for the outside while Jiangyu and Aki are tied down with the statues. She is greeted with the sight of a gargantuan machine, the shape and make of which she has never seen before.
units.displayText: Kuro bolts for the outside while Jiangyu and Aki are tied down with the statues. She is greeted with the sight of a gargantuan machine, the shape and make of which she has never seen before.

spans.text: Kuro bolts for the outside while Jiangyu and Aki are tied down with the statues. She is greeted with the sight of a gargantuan machine, the shape and make of which she has never seen before.

units.rawText: Evidently surprised by the racket Kuro made, its head slowly turns, its eyes locking with Kuro's.
units.displayText: Evidently surprised by the racket Kuro made, its head slowly turns, its eyes locking with Kuro's.

spans.text: Evidently surprised by the racket Kuro made, its head slowly turns, its eyes locking with Kuro's.

units.rawText: H... hello?
units.displayText: H... hello?

spans.text: H... hello?

units.rawText: <size=60>ROAR—!!</size>
units.displayText: ROAR—!!

spans.text: ROAR—!!

units.rawText: <size=60>EE—AHHHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: EE—AHHHHHH!

spans.text: EE—AHHHHHH!

units.rawText: Kuro makes for the security room in a shambling run, not forgetting to slam the door behind her.
units.displayText: Kuro makes for the security room in a shambling run, not forgetting to slam the door behind her.

spans.text: Kuro makes for the security room in a shambling run, not forgetting to slam the door behind her.

units.rawText: Back so soon?
units.displayText: Back so soon?

spans.text: Back so soon?

units.rawText: Haha... you just saved me and everything, how could I, in good conscience, leave you behind?
units.displayText: Haha... you just saved me and everything, how could I, in good conscience, leave you behind?

spans.text: Haha... you just saved me and everything, how could I, in good conscience, leave you behind?

units.rawText: A little suspect, coming from the likes of you...
units.displayText: A little suspect, coming from the likes of you...

spans.text: A little suspect, coming from the likes of you...

units.rawText: But we need all the hands we have right now! Don't pull any funny business, and we'll settle this afterwards!
units.displayText: But we need all the hands we have right now! Don't pull any funny business, and we'll settle this afterwards!

spans.text: But we need all the hands we have right now! Don't pull any funny business, and we'll settle this afterwards!

units.rawText: Focus! The statues are coming!
units.displayText: Focus! The statues are coming!

spans.text: Focus! The statues are coming!
